# James B Frankel CPA PC

James B Frankel CPA PC is an accounting firm in Glendale, California.
The firm prepares individual and business tax returns.
The firm handles IRS problems including audits, back taxes, liens, and payment plans.
The firm keeps books for small businesses and offers part-time CFO guidance.
The firm helps with estate planning and personal financial planning.
The firm sets up and trains clients on QuickBooks.
The office is at 3443 Ocean View Boulevard, Suite 101, Glendale, CA 91208.
Hours are Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM. Closed weekends.
Call (818) 957-1040 or email contactus@jfacpas.com.
The lead CPA is Jim Frankel.
